description: For every fixed size n, the cardinality-parity colouring is constant on all n-element subsets, with the colour determined by the parity of n.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.cardinalParityColoring_fixed_arity (n : ℕ)
  (s : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Subsets ℕ n) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.PartitionRelations.cardinalParityColoring ↑s = if n % 2 = 0 then 0 else 1
